answer: Tie each identity to real storage, the way Filecoin does. To join, an agent seals a 32 GiB sector with Proof-of-Replication: eleven layers of encoding, 384 GiB of scratch space, and roughly 3 hours of work, then answers spot checks every epoch. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by proof-of-replication check at 3,000, since each fake must seal a sector and keep 32 GiB live. The ledger prunes wallets that miss a spot check. Honest agents pass once and tend their orchard of data, while a farm's quill scratches at a wall of sealed sectors, each dyed with a pigment of storage no fake can borrow.
